title: MEPS 2023: people with a reported ICD-10 U09 (post COVID-19 condition, i.e. Long COVID)
definition: People with at least one condition record whose 3-character ICD10CDX equals U09.
method: Sum of unique-person weights (PERWT23F) over the domain; standard error by Taylor linearisation over VARSTR/VARPSU. Person-level, one year only.
comparability: U09 first appears in the 2023 file; earlier years cannot identify Long COVID by code.
MEPS panels overlap across adjacent years: never add or pool these yearly totals.
Condition rows come from household reports coded by professional coders.
From 2023 the file gives event-link flags instead of event counts, so no per-record event averages are computed for this year.
summary: 2023: about 1,207,865 people (95% CI 906,605 to 1,509,125; 78 sampled persons) reported a condition coded U09.
how_to_use: Cross-check or population context only, never a prevalence of Lyme or Long COVID; not a cost estimate (events are counts, not dollars).

provenance.collection_note: Respondent-reported conditions and hours, coded to ICD-10 by MEPS abstractors; not a clinical record.
provenance.computed_by: Computed in code from the federal file; no AI model
provenance.relevance: U09 first appears in the 2023 file; earlier years cannot identify Long COVID by code.
provenance.reliability: 78 sampled persons with a design-based standard error.
